linkedin:
> If you are receiving 429s, read the `Retry-After` header on the response, wait that long, and implement exponential backoff with jitter for when it is absent.

Retrying immediately makes the situation worse. If your own server is returning 429s, check that your rate limiter is counting real client addresses rather than a proxy, because behind a CDN an unconfigured limiter treats all of your traffic as one very busy client and blocks everybody.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/429-too-many-requests/
